findings.description: Re-chunking is correct for the bytes it forwards, but when the chunk-size line is not yet buffered beyond 1024 bytes the path gives up and the client keeps a Connection: keep-alive chunked stream with no 0-terminator, so the client blocks until its own timeout. Precondition: a chunked upstream whose chunk-size line straddles the buffer.
findings.title: A chunked response is abandoned mid-stream on a keep-alive connection without a terminating chunk
